exactOldBlock:
📏 Wie finde ich die richtige Grösse?

Bei Mode- und Schuh-Artikeln findest du eine cm-Grössentabelle direkt auf der jeweiligen Produktseite.
exactTargetBlock:
Was sollte ich vor der Wahl eines Projektors prüfen?

Sieh dir zuerst die Produktansichten und die Angaben zur konkreten Ausführung an. Vergleiche Stromversorgung und Lieferumfang. Ob zusätzliche Funktionen oder bestimmte Motive dazugehören, muss für diese Ausführung ausdrücklich angegeben sein.
prepareRule: Within the selected decoded JSON string only, replace exactOldBlock once with replacementIf + exactTargetBlock + replacementElse + exactOldBlock + replacementEnd. Replace the exact JSON string token in the original raw template text; preserve all other bytes including its leading generated comment. Do not reserialize the whole template.
mandatoryBeforeAnyShopWrite: Read actual connected shop identity and current target collection/theme again
Require current MAIN role, collection ID/handle/default template mapping and raw MD5/SHA exactly as specified
Stop on any mismatch or unknown source; do not silently rebase
Prepare and review the exact one-JSON-path source diff plus rollback bytes
Perform allowed Liquid/theme preview including target and non-target collection; these remain NOT PERFORMED
Obtain the separate concrete owner approval; current handoff is not execution authority
Respect Main-theme write restrictions; no bypass workflow or alternate write API
After any later authorized write, verify actual target/non-target output and preserved unrelated fields
mustRemainUnchanged: all other JSON values and raw source bytes
prices, tags, inventory, variants, collection membership, filters, SEO, discounts and flows
